name: 32129 · Port Orange, FL
findings: ZIP 32129 (Port Orange) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32129 (Port Orange) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32129 (Port Orange) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
